# Reverend Jo

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** St. Columbia  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009)</sub>
- **Role:** minister  <sub>[v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v4 c3 P10](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0010)</sub>
- **Titles:** Rev.  <sub>[v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)</sub>; Reverend  <sub>[v4 c3 P43](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0043)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Jo  <sub>[v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021)</sub>

## Appearance

Jonas is described as a very plain and ugly young man with a big, loose-jointed figure and absurdly long legs. He has green eyes, a large mouth, big ears, and lank tow-colored hair. However, when radiant in his happiness, others hardly consider him plain.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)_

## Personality

Jonas is a pleasant, well-liked person who exhales niceness and easily becomes a general favorite. He enjoys laughing, joking, and socializing, sometimes drawing mild disapproval from older ladies for his jovial nature. He is decisive, thoughtful, and dedicated to his duty.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c25 P12](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0012), [v3 c27 P25](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0025)_

## Traits

- decisive  <sub>[v3 c27 P25](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0025)</sub>
- jovial  <sub>[v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012)</sub>
- dutiful  <sub>[v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019)</sub>

## Abilities

- delivering eloquent prayers  <sub>[v4 c4 P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016)</sub>

## Goals

- to faithfully do the work assigned to him by God as a minister  <sub>[v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019)</sub>

## History

Jonas Blake was a theological student from St. Columbia who took charge of the Point Prospect Mission Church for a summer. During his time at St. Columbia, he befriended Philippa Gordon, spending time fishing, boating, and walking together. Although he had long tried to avoid entering the ministry, he ultimately committed himself to the work. He frequently visited Patty's Place while traveling from St. Columbia and gained the affection of the household. Over time, he fell in love with Phil and proposed to her, giving her advice on decision-making. After meeting Phil's family, he won over both of her parents, and they were married the following June. By the time of Anne Shirley's wedding, Jonas and Phil had children, and he assisted in Anne's wedding ceremony by offering a praised wedding prayer.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v3 c25 P12](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0012), [v3 c27 P19](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0019), [v3 c27 P25](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0025), [v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v4 c3 P44](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0044), [v4 c4 P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016)_
